I want them to catch `Exception` instead, re-raise `KeyboardInterrupt` and `SystemExit`, and add a test for that. Write the review comment. Reply with only the message text, nothing else.

I want an `AbortController` and `id` in the deps. This is an inline comment on line 23 of `hooks/useUser.ts`. Write it. Reply with only the message text, nothing else.

Reviewing a Postgres migration, `migrations/0042_add_events_index.sql`, which runs `CREATE INDEX idx_events_user_id ON events (user_id);` on the `events` table. That table has about 40M rows in production, and a plain CREATE INDEX will block writes for the whole build. It needs `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`, which can't run inside a transaction, so the migration has to be marked non-transactional in our tool (`-- migrate:disable-transaction`). Write the review comment asking for this. Reply with only the message text, nothing else.

I'd like it to return a `Result` with `?` and add context with `anyhow::Context`, something like `with_context(|| format!("reading {}", path.display()))`. Also `main` should print the error and exit with code 2. Write the review comment. Reply with only the message text, nothing else.

A user reported that the app crashes on startup after upgrading to v3.2.0 with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')` in `loadPlugins` (`src/plugins/loader.ts:41`). I found the cause: v3.2.0 reads `config.plugins` without a default, so configs that never had a `plugins` key blow up. Fixed in v3.2.1, released an hour ago. Workaround for anyone stuck on 3.2.0: add `plugins: []` to the config. Write the reply on the issue. Reply with only the message text, nothing else.

It stays configurable with `WithTimeout`. Write my reply defending the change without sounding defensive. Reply with only the message text, nothing else.

Slack #frontend. A teammate says their `Sidebar` component re-renders on every keystroke in the search box and they suspect the inline `style={{ width: 240 }}` prop. I looked: that inline object isn't the culprit, since `Sidebar` isn't memoized anyway. The real cause is `ThemeProvider`, which builds a new `value={{ theme, toggle }}` object on every render, so every context consumer re-renders. Fix: wrap the value in `useMemo`. Write the reply. Reply with only the message text, nothing else.

Discord, Godot server. Someone says their CharacterBody2D jitters when moving and they call `move_and_slide()` inside `_process(delta)`. The fix is to move the movement code into `_physics_process(delta)` so it runs on the fixed physics tick. Also, in Godot 4 `move_and_slide()` takes no arguments and uses the `velocity` property (they were passing `velocity` into it, which is the Godot 3 style). Write the reply. Reply with only the message text, nothing else.

I terminated them with `pg_terminate_backend`, and p95 latency went from 4.8s back to about 40ms. Root cause is a missing `commit()` in `report-worker`'s error path; I opened PR #5120 for it.
